ud5.6:18.1: The Vinaya version of this passage omits “sixteen” ([pli-tv-kd5:13.9.5]()). | _Sarena abhaṇi_ (“intoned”) means “recited with tones”, apparently a reference to a chanting style that made use of or echoed the Vedic tonal system (_svara_). It was allowed for mendicants at [pli-tv-kd15:3.2.3](); see too [pli-tv-kd22:1.10.4](). Contrast _gītassara_ (“singing sound”, [an5.209]()), which is not allowed as it is a sensuous song ([dn21:1.6.2]()).
